name: actual-default-bcrypt-operation
args: if(process.env.PREBUILDS_ONLY)throw Error("Global prebuild bypass forbidden in acceptance");const {createRequire}=require("node:module");const r=createRequire("/artifact/resources/app.asar/package.json");const selected=r("node-gyp-build").path("/artifact/resources/app.asar/node_modules/bcrypt");if(!selected.endsWith("prebuilds/linux-x64/bcrypt.glibc.node"))throw Error("Unexpected native selection "+selected);const bcrypt=r("bcrypt");(async()=>{const hash=await bcrypt.hash("owned Unicode 🎹 fixture",12);const correct=await bcrypt.compare("owned Unicode 🎹 fixture",hash),incorrect=await bcrypt.compare("wrong fixture",hash);if(!correct||incorrect||bcrypt.getRounds(hash)!==12)throw Error("Actual bcrypt acceptance failed");console.log(JSON.stringify({selected,version:r("bcrypt/package.json").version,correctPasswordAccepted:correct,wrongPasswordRejected:!incorrect,cost:bcrypt.getRounds(hash),prebuildsOnlyOverridePresent:false}));})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1});
